start:
@startuml
actor Customer
actor Member
usecase "Place Order" as UC1
usecase "Track Order" as UC2
usecase "Pay" as UC3
usecase "Cancel Order" as UC4
rectangle "Online Shop" {
  UC1
  UC3
}
Customer -- UC1
UC1 ..> UC3 : <<include>>
@enduml

target.name: Relation segment 1 of usecase:1 — Enter to select, Delete to remove

  - button "✕ Delete"

    - option "Association"
    - option "Directed"
    - option "include" [selected]
    - option "extend"
    - option "Generalize"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Member"
    - option "UC1 - Place Order"
    - option "UC2 - Track Order"
    - option "UC3 - Pay" [selected]
    - option "UC4 - Cancel Order"
    - option "Online Shop"
  - text: Target endpoint

    - option "Customer"

    - option "UC1 - Place Order" [selected]
    - option "UC2 - Track Order"
    - option "UC3 - Pay"
    - option "UC4 - Cancel Order"
    - option "Online Shop"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - text: Stereotype
  - textbox "Stereotype": <<include>>
  - button "Invert direction"

  - button "Add teaching callout"
